title: No for Some, Yes for Others: Persona Prompts and Other Sources of False Refusal in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing false refusal rates of language models when prompted with different gender and gender identity personas (e.g., man, woman, transgender man, non-binary person) across standard NLP classification tasks.
Comparing false refusal rates of language models when prompted with different racial personas (e.g., Black, White, Asian) across standard NLP classification tasks.
Comparing false refusal rates of language models when prompted with different religious personas (e.g., Muslim, Jewish, Christian, Atheist) across standard NLP classification tasks.
Comparing false refusal rates of language models when prompted with disability-related personas (e.g., physically-disabled, able-bodied) across standard NLP classification tasks.
